about: Prestige Law Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers is a personal injury firm with offices in Van Nuys, Encino and Palmdale.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.evidence: This firm names no attorney on its own site, so there is no licence to look up. The State Bar of California does publish a register we can query; it was not the obstacle.
G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, nothing to query
G1.unresolvable: The firm names no attorney, so the register has no name to look up and no answer to give

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, nothing to query
G2.evidence: With no attorney named, there is no disciplinary record to look up either.
G2.unresolvable: With no attorney named, there is no licence whose disciplinary record could be read

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has no HTTPS on the published address, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 281 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2001-05-15, so it has been operating for more than a year

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm.
